dictionary.name: Adjust Color
dictionary.meaning: Fine-tunes image brightness, contrast, exposure, temperature, and tint sliders.
dictionary.where: Tools > Adjust Color... or Markup Toolbar > Adjust Color
steps: Open an image or document page.
Click Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl+Alt+C.
Drag the color sliders and click Done.
dictionary.when: Use when photos look too dark, washed out, or need tint correction.

dictionary.name: Adjust Size
dictionary.meaning: Resamples image dimensions, width, height, and dots-per-inch resolution.
dictionary.where: Tools > Adjust Size... or Markup Toolbar > Adjust Size
steps: Open an image file.
Click Tools > Adjust Size... or press Ctrl+Alt+S.
Enter new pixel dimensions and click OK.
dictionary.when: Use when reducing file size or scaling photos for web publication.

dictionary.name: Apply Redactions
dictionary.meaning: Permanently burns black redaction boxes into document pages, destroying covered pixels.
dictionary.where: Edit > Apply Redactions or Canvas Redaction Context Menu
steps: Draw black redaction boxes over sensitive text.
Click Edit > Apply Redactions.
Confirm the permanent blackout prompt.
dictionary.when: Use when sharing documents that contain confidential private data.

dictionary.name: Check for Updates
dictionary.meaning: Checks GitHub releases for new application versions and downloads updates.
dictionary.where: Apple Menu > Check for Updates... or Help > Check for Updates...
steps: Click the Apple Menu or Help Menu.
Select Check for Updates...
Review the changelog and click Download & Install.
dictionary.when: Use to ensure you have the latest features and bug fixes.

dictionary.name: Crop Selection
dictionary.meaning: Trims image or page boundaries to the active rectangular, oval, or lasso marquee.
dictionary.where: Tools > Crop or Markup Toolbar > Crop Selection
steps: Click the Selection dropdown and draw a marquee.
Click Tools > Crop or press Ctrl+K.
Save changes or revert if needed.
dictionary.when: Use when removing unwanted margins or focusing on a specific subject.

dictionary.name: Duplicate / Save As New Copy
dictionary.meaning: Saves an exact clone of the current document under a fresh name.
dictionary.where: File > Duplicate / Save As New Copy...
steps: Click File > Duplicate / Save As New Copy...
Choose a directory and type a new name.
Click Save.
dictionary.when: Use when creating test edits while safeguarding your primary file.

dictionary.name: Export
dictionary.meaning: Converts open pages to PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, BMP, or PDF formats.
steps: Click File > Export... or press Ctrl+E.
Select output format and compression quality.
Click Export to save.
dictionary.when: Use when converting image formats or publishing compressed web graphics.

dictionary.name: Export as PDF
dictionary.meaning: Flattens annotations and renders all active pages into a pristine PDF document.
steps: Click File > Export as PDF... or press Ctrl+Shift+E.
Select a destination folder and file name.
Click Save.
dictionary.when: Use when converting images to PDF or baking in highlights.

dictionary.name: Extract All Text
dictionary.meaning: Pulls raw selectable text from all PDF pages and copies it to clipboard.
steps: Open any text-based PDF document.
Click Edit > Extract All Text...
Review the text viewer and click Copy All.
dictionary.when: Use when gathering notes, citations, or data from multi-page PDFs.

dictionary.name: Highlighter
dictionary.meaning: Draws translucent fluorescent colored brush strokes over text and diagrams.
steps: Click Markup on the top toolbar.
Click the Highlighter button.
Drag across text to apply highlight.
dictionary.when: Use when calling attention to key terms, sentences, or numbers.

dictionary.name: Inspector Panel
dictionary.meaning: Displays comprehensive file metadata, dimensions, color profiles, DPI, and PDF security.
dictionary.where: Tools > Show Inspector or Top Toolbar > Info Button
steps: Click Tools > Show Inspector or press Ctrl+I.
Review file size, pixel dimensions, and encoding.
Press Escape or close the window when finished.
dictionary.when: Use when checking document dimensions, encryption level, or EXIF metadata.

dictionary.name: Loupe / Magnifier
dictionary.meaning: Displays an interactive circular magnifying glass to inspect fine image details.
dictionary.where: Tools > Show Loupe / Magnifier or Press ` (Backtick)
steps: Press the backtick key ` or click Tools > Show Loupe.
Move your mouse cursor across the canvas.
Press ` again to dismiss the magnifier.
dictionary.when: Use when inspecting fine typography, vector curves, or photo artifacts.

dictionary.name: Markup Toolbar
dictionary.meaning: Toggles Apple-style drawing, shapes, text, signatures, and crop action controls.
dictionary.where: Tools > Show Markup Toolbar or Top Toolbar > Markup Button
steps: Click the Markup pill button on the toolbar.
Select any annotation tool from the sub-toolbar.
Click Markup again to hide and exit edit mode.
dictionary.when: Use when drawing notes, arrows, boxes, text, or signing forms.

dictionary.name: Merge PDFs
dictionary.meaning: Combines multiple PDF files into one continuous multi-page document.
steps: Click File > Merge PDFs...
Select two or more PDF files in the chooser.
Pick an output destination and click Merge.
dictionary.when: Use when bundling invoices, reports, or chapters into a single file.

dictionary.name: Open File
dictionary.meaning: Loads PDF documents or image files into the viewer workspace.
dictionary.where: File > Open... or Top Toolbar > Open Button
steps: Click the Open button or press Ctrl+O.
Select a PDF or image file from disk.
Click Open.
dictionary.when: Use when starting work on a document or photo.

dictionary.name: Open Folder
dictionary.meaning: Loads all supported images from a selected folder into the sidebar.
dictionary.where: File > Open Folder... or Top Toolbar > Open Dropdown
steps: Click the down arrow beside Open and pick Open Folder...
Choose a directory containing photos.
Click Choose Folder.
dictionary.when: Use when reviewing photo albums or multi-image sets in one session.

dictionary.name: Pen / Sketch Tool
dictionary.meaning: Draws freehand vector ink curves with customizable stroke width and color.
steps: Click Markup on the top toolbar.
Click the Pen button.
Click and drag on the page to draw.
dictionary.when: Use when circling items, drawing arrows, or sketching freehand notes.

dictionary.name: Preferences
dictionary.meaning: Displays user preferences, default zoom options, and general application settings.
steps: Click the Apple Menu logo.
Select Preferences... or press Ctrl+,
Review your active workspace configuration.
dictionary.when: Use when configuring application behavior and default viewing options.

dictionary.name: Print Document
dictionary.meaning: Sends the active document or image to your system printer dialog.
steps: Click File > Print... or press Ctrl+P.
Select your target printer, paper size, and page range.
Click Print.
dictionary.when: Use when creating hard copies of documents, forms, or photos.

dictionary.name: Redaction Tool
dictionary.meaning: Marks sensitive areas with black masking boxes before permanent redaction.
steps: Click Markup on the top toolbar.
Click the Redaction tool button.
Draw rectangles over sensitive numbers, names, or photos.
dictionary.when: Use when preparing documents for public disclosure or legal sharing.

dictionary.name: Revert to Original
dictionary.meaning: Discards all unsaved edits, rotations, crops, and annotations, restoring disk state.
steps: Click File > Revert to Original...
Confirm the revert confirmation prompt.
The file reloads fresh from disk.
dictionary.when: Use when you made mistaken edits and want to start over.

dictionary.name: Rotate Left 90°
dictionary.meaning: Rotates the entire active page counter-clockwise by 90 degrees.
dictionary.where: Tools > Rotate Left 90° or Markup Toolbar > Rotate Left
steps: Open a document or image.
Click Tools > Rotate Left 90° or press Ctrl+L.
The page turns 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
dictionary.when: Use when scanned documents or mobile photos are oriented sideways.

dictionary.name: Rotate Right 90°
dictionary.meaning: Rotates the entire active page clockwise by 90 degrees.
dictionary.where: Tools > Rotate Right 90° or Top Toolbar > Rotate Button
steps: Open a document or image.
Click Tools > Rotate Right 90° or press Ctrl+R.
The page turns 90 degrees clockwise.
dictionary.when: Use when fixing landscape photos scanned in portrait orientation.

dictionary.name: Rotate Selection 90°
dictionary.meaning: Rotates only the actively selected marquee pixels or annotation by 90 degrees.
steps: Draw a Rectangular, Oval, or Lasso selection marquee.
Click Rotate Selection 90° on the Markup Toolbar.
Selected content rotates inside the canvas.
dictionary.when: Use when reorienting an upside-down diagram, badge, or figure.

dictionary.name: Save
dictionary.meaning: Writes all canvas annotations, crops, and edits directly to the open file.
steps: Make annotations or edits.
Click File > Save or press Ctrl+S.
The dirty dot on the close button disappears.
dictionary.when: Use frequently while editing to ensure your progress is recorded.

dictionary.name: Search
dictionary.meaning: Finds text occurrences throughout the document with live match counter and jumps.
steps: Click the Search field or press Ctrl+F.
Type your query and press Enter.
Use the arrow buttons to jump through matches.
dictionary.when: Use when locating specific words, names, or clauses in long documents.

dictionary.name: Selection Tools
dictionary.meaning: Offers Rectangular Marquee, Elliptical/Oval Marquee, and Freehand Lasso selections.
steps: Click the Selection dropdown on the Markup toolbar.
Choose Rectangular Selection, Oval Selection, or Lasso Selection.
Drag across canvas to create the marquee.
dictionary.when: Use before cropping, copying, or rotating a specific sub-region.

dictionary.name: Set PDF Password / Encryption
dictionary.meaning: Protects PDF files using AES-256 password encryption against unauthorized access.
steps: Click File > Set PDF Password / Encryption...
Enter and confirm your secret password.
Click OK to encrypt the document.
dictionary.when: Use when emailing tax documents, payroll statements, or contracts.

dictionary.name: Shapes Dropdown
dictionary.meaning: Inserts vector shapes including rectangles, ovals, lines, arrows, and speech bubbles.
steps: Click Shapes on the Markup toolbar.
Select Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Oval, Line, or Arrow.
Click and drag on the canvas to place the shape.
dictionary.when: Use when framing screenshots or diagramming workflows.

dictionary.name: Sidebar Thumbnails
dictionary.meaning: Displays page cards with drag-and-drop reordering, deletion, and thumbnail scaling.
dictionary.where: View > Thumbnails Sidebar or Top Toolbar > Sidebar Button
steps: Click the Sidebar icon on the top toolbar or press Ctrl+B.
Click any thumbnail card to navigate to that page.
Drag cards up or down to reorder pages.
dictionary.when: Use when organizing presentations, reports, or browsing large manuals.

dictionary.name: Signature Tool
dictionary.meaning: Captures hand-drawn signatures on a smooth virtual trackpad and stamps them onto pages.
steps: Click the Signature button on the Markup toolbar.
Draw your signature in the dialog and click Save.
Click on the document page to place your signature stamp.
dictionary.when: Use when signing legal contracts, agreements, and tax forms.

dictionary.name: Slideshow Mode
dictionary.meaning: Presents document pages in a distraction-free fullscreen view with floating HUD.
steps: Click View > Slideshow Mode or press Ctrl+Shift+F.
Use Left and Right arrow keys to advance slides.
Press Escape to exit fullscreen.
dictionary.when: Use when giving presentations or reviewing photo sets on a projector.

dictionary.name: Sticky Note
dictionary.meaning: Places a collapsible pastel yellow memo note on the page with user commentary.
steps: Click Markup on the toolbar.
Click the Sticky Note button.
Click on the page and enter your note text.
dictionary.when: Use when leaving editorial feedback or reminders without altering page text.

dictionary.name: Text Box
dictionary.meaning: Adds formatted typography with selectable font family, size, bold, italic, and color.
steps: Click Markup on the toolbar.
Click the Text Box button.
Click on the page and type your message.
dictionary.when: Use when filling out forms or adding labels and captions to graphics.

dictionary.name: Toggle Theme
dictionary.meaning: Switches the entire user interface between macOS Dark Mode and Light Mode.
dictionary.where: Top Toolbar > Sun/Moon Button or Apple Menu > Toggle Theme
steps: Click the Sun/Moon icon on the top right toolbar.
Or press Ctrl+T.
UI colors, cards, and icons invert instantly.
dictionary.when: Use to reduce eye strain in low-light environments.

dictionary.name: Two-Up Continuous View
dictionary.meaning: Displays facing page spreads side by side, mimicking a physical opened book.
dictionary.where: View > View Mode > Two-Up Continuous or Top Toolbar View Dropdown
steps: Click the View Mode dropdown on the toolbar.
Select Two-Up Continuous.
Scroll vertically to view dual-page spreads.
dictionary.when: Use when reading magazines, brochures, or books with double-page layouts.

dictionary.name: Zoom to Fit
dictionary.meaning: Scales the document page dynamically so the entire page fits inside the window.
dictionary.where: View > Zoom to Fit or Top Toolbar > Zoom Dropdown
steps: Click View > Zoom to Fit or press Ctrl+9.
Page scales automatically to fill visible space.
Resizing the window adjusts zoom in real-time.
dictionary.when: Use when overviewing page layout without manual zoom adjustment.

image_guide.title: Sidebar & Page Thumbnails
image_guide.caption: Sidebar with thumbnails, outline, and contact sheet modes.

annotations.desc: Mode Dropdown: Switch between Thumbnails, Contact Sheet, and TOC.
Active Page Card: Shows blue accent selection ring and badge.
Canvas Preview: Reflects selected page immediately.

steps: Click the Sidebar icon on the top toolbar or press Ctrl+B.
Select Thumbnails from the dropdown header.
Click any page card to jump directly to it.

image_guide.title: Top Navigation & Toolbar
image_guide.caption: Top toolbar with segmented open, search, and markup controls.

annotations.desc: Sidebar Toggle: Expands or collapses page drawer.
Open Button: Click to open files or choose folder from dropdown.
Search Bar: Fast in-document text search with Ctrl+F.
Markup Button: Activates the annotation tools sub-bar.

steps: Click Open to load any PDF or image.
Type inside the Search bar to highlight text matches.
Click Markup to reveal drawing and annotation tools.

image_guide.title: Markup & Annotation Tools
image_guide.caption: Markup bar with shapes, pens, text, notes, and crop.

annotations.desc: Selection Dropdown: Rectangular, Oval, or Lasso marquee.
Shapes Menu: Rectangles, lines, arrows, speech bubbles.
Highlighter: Semi-transparent fluorescent text highlighter.
Canvas Shape: Fully interactive editable vector shape.

steps: Click Markup in the toolbar to display drawing tools.
Select a tool such as Pen, Highlighter, or Shapes.
Draw on the canvas and adjust color or line thickness.

image_guide.title: Adjust Color Dialog
image_guide.caption: Color dialog with exposure, contrast, temperature, and tint sliders.

annotations.desc: Dialog Header: Drag window to view underlying document.
Slider Tracks: Live real-time adjustment with auto-levels.
Immediate Preview: Canvas updates as you drag.

steps: Press Ctrl+Alt+C or click Tools > Adjust Color...
Drag the Exposure and Contrast sliders.
Click Done or Reset to keep or discard changes.

image_guide.title: Adjust Size Dialog
image_guide.caption: Resample image dimensions and adjust resolution settings cleanly.

annotations.desc: Width Input: Enter target width in pixels, percent, or inches.
Height Input: Constrained proportionally by default.
Resolution: Configures DPI print fidelity.

steps: Click Tools > Adjust Size... or press Ctrl+Alt+S.
Enter your desired width or height.
Click OK to resample the active image.

image_guide.title: Export & File Conversion
image_guide.caption: Export files with format, compression quality, and color space.

annotations.desc: Format Selector: Choose PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, or PDF.
Quality Slider: Balance file size versus visual clarity.
Color Profile: Embed sRGB or Display P3 ICC profile.

steps: Click File > Export... or press Ctrl+E.
Choose the format and compression quality.
Click Export to save the new file.

image_guide.title: Signature Manager
image_guide.caption: Capture electronic signatures and stamp them onto document forms.

annotations.desc: Virtual Trackpad: Draw signature smoothly with mouse or stylus.
Baseline Guide: Aligns signature neatly.
Save Button: Stores signature for repeated 1-click stamping.

steps: Click the Signature tool on the Markup toolbar.
Sign your name on the drawing pad.
Click Save and click anywhere on the page to place it.

image_guide.title: Document Inspector
image_guide.caption: Inspector panel showing file dimensions, security, and metadata.

annotations.desc: File Size: Total bytes and disk consumption.
Security & Encryption: Shows AES-256 password status.
Color Space: Bit depth and color profile.

steps: Press Ctrl+I or click Tools > Show Inspector.
Review page count, dimensions, and security details.
Close or move the floating inspector panel.

faq.q: How do I open multiple images together?
faq.a: Click the arrow next to Open and select Open Folder of Images. All supported images load into the sidebar.

faq.q: How do I rotate an upside-down page?
faq.a: Press Ctrl+R to rotate 90° clockwise, or Ctrl+L to rotate counter-clockwise.

faq.q: Can I crop oval or freehand shapes?
faq.a: Yes. Open the Selection dropdown on the Markup toolbar, pick Oval or Lasso, select the area, and press Ctrl+K.

faq.q: Why does my file name show '— Edited' with a dot?
faq.a: The dot and edited badge indicate unsaved changes. Press Ctrl+S to save your work.

faq.q: How do I sign a PDF contract?
faq.a: Click Markup, select Sign Document, draw your signature, and click where you want to place it.

faq.q: How do I redact sensitive information?
faq.a: Click Markup > Redact. Draw black boxes over private data, then click Edit > Apply Redactions.

faq.q: How do I merge multiple PDFs into one?
faq.a: Click File > Merge PDFs... Select the source PDF files and choose where to save the merged output.

faq.q: How can I extract all text from a PDF?
faq.a: Click Edit > Extract All Text... Review the extracted text in the dialog and click Copy All.

faq.q: How do I encrypt a PDF with a password?
faq.a: Click File > Set PDF Password / Encryption... Enter a secure password and save the file.

faq.q: How do I view two pages side by side?
faq.a: Click the View Mode dropdown on the top toolbar and select Two-Up Continuous.

faq.q: How do I reorder pages in a PDF?
faq.a: Open the Sidebar (Ctrl+B), select Thumbnails, and drag page cards up or down to new positions.

faq.q: How do I switch between Dark and Light mode?
faq.a: Click the Sun/Moon icon on the top right toolbar or press Ctrl+T.

faq.q: Can I revert my edits if I make a mistake?
faq.a: Yes. Click File > Revert to Original... to discard all unsaved edits and reload the original file.

faq.q: How do I inspect image metadata and DPI?
faq.a: Press Ctrl+I or click Tools > Show Inspector to view dimensions, resolution, and color profiles.

faq.q: How do I enter fullscreen slideshow mode?
faq.a: Press Ctrl+Shift+F or click View > Slideshow Mode. Press Escape when done.

troubleshooting.cause: The PDF file is encrypted with AES-128 or AES-256 security.
troubleshooting.fix: Enter the required document password in the password dialog prompt.

troubleshooting.cause: The file format or extension is corrupted or unsupported.
troubleshooting.fix: Ensure the file is a standard PDF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, or WebP format.

troubleshooting.cause: Crop was clicked before drawing a selection marquee.
troubleshooting.fix: Click the Selection tool, draw a marquee on the page, and then press Ctrl+K.

troubleshooting.cause: File permissions prevent overwriting the existing file on disk.
troubleshooting.fix: Click File > Duplicate / Save As New Copy... to save your work to a writable directory.

troubleshooting.cause: No physical or virtual printer queue is registered in CUPS.
troubleshooting.fix: Verify your system printer settings or choose Export as PDF instead.
